SELECTED_INDEX: 6
CONFIDENCE: 0.45
EXPLANATION: The spectrum is dominated by features of a terminal vinyl group together with aliphatic /-CH3 stretches and an ether C–O stretch.  Key matches: 1648 cm⁻¹ (ν(C=C) of CH2=CH–), strong CH stretches at 3022 / 3090 cm⁻¹ (═CH2), aliphatic CH stretches at 2873–2989 cm⁻¹, CH2 scissoring at 1458–1424 cm⁻¹, and the characteristic out-of-plane vinyl CH2 deformations at 923, 890 and 835 cm⁻¹.  The band at 1094 cm⁻¹ fits the ν(C–O–C) stretch of an ether.  Among the candidates only molecule 6 (C=COCC(C)C) contains exactly a terminal vinyl group attached to an ether oxygen and aliphatic branching, matching all these Raman features without introducing groups (carbonyl, amide, halogen) that would give additional bands not observed.
